c21Open: Pen Weng. Routine net check, pen three.
c21Crew: Keep lights low. You'll spook the fish.
c21Task: R-One, follow the net with clearance.
c21Billow: R-One, that panel bows out. Give it room.
c21Snag: Tension up. Could be a rope.
c21Idle: R-One, the white float is twelve o'clock.
c21Timeout: Leave unchecked netting open. I'll mark its extent.
c22Open: Dead fish on the bottom. Bring them up.
c22Crew: Secure the grip before lifting. Trim will shift.
c22Task: I'll follow you with the line. Keep it off the bottom.
c22Silt: Let it clear. Look for the outline.
c22Idle: R-One, sight back from the basket to the last fish.
c22Timeout: Bring the basket in. Give the farm the remaining count.
c23Crew: Hold. Listen in. Current building. Twelve-minute window.
c23Task: R-One, find the hole. Leave the fish.
c23Found: There. Face it square. Clock position? Depth?
c23Idle: R-One, look for the break in the mesh.
c23Timeout: Window closed. Pass our search coverage to Pen.
c23Relief: Repair crew in place. You can recover.
c23Ending: Trainee days are over. You can fly.
c23Schedule: 28 August · Trial wind farm job · Leg C | Twenty minutes of slack water left
